capability.selection: One primary by default; one secondary only with --need-secondary and a recorded contribution.
capability.framework_detection: package.json dependency groups plus framework config filenames; React runtime requires react or react-dom metadata, including hybrid frameworks.
non_react_routes_checked: React animations to GSAP or CSS/WAAPI
UI components/forms to UI/UX Pro Max and native HTML dialog/forms
React interactive elements to CEOS Creative Coding
pmndrs/examples to CEOS 3D or vanilla Three.js
capability.orchestration: CEOS owns creative orchestration; existing project engineering policy remains authoritative; Superpowers routes only to TDD or verification.

verification.workflow: .github/workflows/verify.yml runs the routing tests in its existing source job; no browser job was added.
verification.repository_check_summary: PASS: 14 skill schemas, 4 locked template contracts, standard/team docs, backup exclusion; node, npm, git, bun, playwright-cli, lighthouse, and blender found.

routing_suite.mode_selection: FAST trivial CSS without concept gates; STANDARD default and expanded-scope escalation; FLAGSHIP; explicit override.
routing_suite.react_constraint: React Bits, shadcn, and pmndrs are excluded without a declared React runtime; four React-first routes return tested vanilla/native/CEOS fallbacks; explicit override and without-React constraint cannot enable them.
routing_suite.hybrid_framework: Astro remains the detected framework while declared React dependencies enable React routes.
routing_suite.secondary: Opt-in only; contribution is included; incompatible React-only secondaries are omitted.
routing_suite.availability_fallback: Available secondary is promoted when preferred is undetected; preferred is marked not detected if neither route capability is available.

contextSizeProxy.label: Static proxy; no live telemetry
contextSizeProxy.method: UTF-8 byte counts; approximate tokens are ceil(bytes / 4), not provider tokenization.
contextSizeProxy.sample_task: Create a wireframe for the signup flow
contextSizeProxy.router_command: python3 scripts/ceos-route.py "Create a wireframe for the signup flow" --project .

full_entry_skill_set.definition: All skills/ceos-*/SKILL.md files, including ceos-start-here; excludes library references, START-HERE.md, host prompts, and project instructions.

limitations: The routed proxy includes the CLI text and one repository-owned primary skill file; external skills may have different sizes.
The full-set comparator is the 14 CEOS core skill Markdown files, not the third-party library or runtime prompts.
No live model token telemetry was collected.
Phrase matching is deterministic but cannot resolve every natural-language ambiguity; route IDs are available.
Filesystem discovery cannot prove that the host loaded or can invoke a selected capability.
No rendered site or browser interaction was changed or verified by this routing task.
The context-size comparison is a static proxy, not live telemetry.
